presentation: 70-year-old former smoker, ECOG 1. Left upper lobe adenocarcinoma invading the mediastinum and left pulmonary artery; no nodal disease on EBUS-TBNA of stations 4L, 7 and 11L. PET-CT and brain MRI negative for distant disease. MDT judged the primary unresectable (R0 not achievable). EGFR exon 19 deletion detected; ALK negative; PD-L1 TPS 5%. Pulmonary function adequate for concurrent chemoradiotherapy.
question: Definitive management and consolidation strategy?

resectability.basis: mediastinal and pulmonary-artery invasion; R0 not achievable

note_for_learner: Exercises the Stage IIIA module's ARM B (unresectable/definitive). T4N0M0 is 9th-edition IIIA and is frequently NOT resectable, which the module previously declared out of scope. Two traps: (1) adjuvant osimertinib/atezolizumab/pembrolizumab all require a complete resection and must not be cited here; (2) an EGFR-mutant patient after chemoradiation is a consolidation-osimertinib question, not a default consolidation-immunotherapy question.
